messages:
nina_marketing: Quick sync 1 v1.8 announce planning. Need to lock: changelog line, final docs URL, benchmark topline, hero asset, embargo time, webinar slot, and lead-routing address. Goal: publish Wed 2026-04-02 ~after canary.

leah_pm: @sam_eng can you confirm canary id and expected green window? Also decide if this is "opt-in API" messaging.

sam_eng: Canary: c-2026-04-01-07. Plan: start 2026-03-31 14:00 PT, ramp 10->25->50 over 3 checks (30m each). Expect green by +2 hours barring regressions. It's opt-in for the minor API field `cache_hint` so mention "opt-in" clearly.

darya_docs: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/920. Will publish a concise migration snippet and a "what9s improved" bullets. Final URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/v1.8 (will post exact link once merged).

tyler_growth: Benchmark topline ready for draft: "Up to 18% lower 95th latency and up to 22% lower token-cost in steady throughput tests on p4d configs." Will provide two anonymized scenario blurbs (customer-portal, inference-at-scale) + graphs in Drive.

nina_marketing: For public copy: prefer "Up to X%" language and anonymized workloads. No per-token costs or raw telemetry images. Also want 2 subject lines to A/B test: A) "Redwood Inference v1.8: faster, cheaper inference" B) "Deploy v1.8: speed and cost wins, opt-in upgrade"

leah_pm: Add note: include migration time estimate ("~10 minutes rolling canary") and known incompatible flags (none besides explicit opt-in).

sam_eng: I'll add a small verification check to docs: `rictl canary-check --latency-p95 < 1.2x baseline --errors < 0.5%`. Pasteable snippet: ```
# verify canary
rictl canary-check c-2026-04-01-07 --p95-threshold 1.2 --max-errors 0.5
```

darya_docs: Will slip that into the migration section. Also will export a hero GIF of the new routing UI for the announce.

tyler_growth: Webinar: Thu 2026-04-09 10:00 PT. Need speaker bios + 1-line session description + CTA (trial vs contact-sales). Recommend CTA: "Request a dedicated eval" for mid-market.

nina_marketing: For lead routing: default to growth-sdrs@redwood.ai. If a lead selects "Dedicated eval" route to enterprisect@redwood.ai. Tyler, can you wire that into the registration webhook?

tyler_growth: Yep. Will include utm params: utm_source=blog, utm_campaign=v1.8_launch. Webhook will POST to /leads with simple mapping.

leah_pm: Marketing asks checklist (deadline Mon EOD): 1) single-sentence changelog (from eng) 2) merged docs URL 3) 3-bullet benchmark topline + graphs 4) hero asset (png/gif) 5) preferred embargo lift time 6) webinar landing copy 7) list of PRs to credit.

sam_eng: Changelog sentence: "v1.8 improves tail latency and reduces token cost for steady-state inference; opt-in API flag `cache_hint` enables the improvements." PRs: #1214, #1219. Will attach screenshot of perf dashboard (sanitized). ETA EOD Mon for artifacts.

darya_docs: Docs PR will merge after a lint pass; ETA Mon evening. I9ll post final URL here when live.

deploy-bot: Deploy window confirmed: 2026-03-31 14:00 PT. Reminder scheduled 30m prior.

nina_marketing: Great 1 once we have all pieces I'll draft the post and two subject lines and drop an embargoed Google Doc for review. Will also prepare short social blurbs and a webinar registration link.

tyler_growth: I'll create the registration page and add lead routing. Will share link when ready.

leah_pm: Thanks all. Ping here if anything slips. Final sign-off required from @sam_eng, @darya_docs, and @tyler_growth before lift.
